overrideProperties.Name: AK 7.62x39 FAB Defense Ultimag 30R 30-round magazine (RAL 8000) (Tape)
overrideProperties.Description: A 30-round windowed polymer magazine for 7.62x39 AKs and compatible weapons, manufactured by FAB Defense. Can also be supplied with .366 TKM ammo for use with the corresponding caliber AK-compatible weapons. RAL 8000 Version. Tape Version. Change the tape color from the magazine menu in your stash.
